rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Life's origin is a chemistry story. Oparin and Haldane proposed that a reducing early atmosphere — methane, ammonia, hydrogen and water vapour — energised by lightning and ultraviolet light, cooked simple organics into the oceans' primordial soup, where macromolecules, coacervate droplets and finally self-replicating RNA systems gave rise to the first anaerobic cells.…

rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Chemical evolution: Inorganic (CH4, NH3, H2O, H2) → Simple organics (amino acids, sugars, bases) → Polymers → Proto-cells → Life
Miller-Urey: electric sparks (lightning) + reducing atmosphere → amino acids

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: **Coacervate vs cell:** coacervate = protein-lipid droplet with some internal chemistry but no true heredity; a cell has a genome and division.  ·  **Chemical vs biological evolution:** chemical evolution built the first molecules/cells; biological evolution (natural selection) acts on replicating organisms afterwards.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: NEB expects the Miller-Urey experiment (setup + results + significance) as a standard question.  ·  The Oparin-Haldane theory and its 4 stages are a frequent long-answer.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: ***Stromatolites*** — layered fossil mounds built by cyanobacteria ~3.5 bya; Earth's oldest fossils.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: The 2022 question names three required parts: chemicals used, products obtained, significance — answer all three in order.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: **Q.** What was the primordial soup? **Answer.** The early ocean (roughly 4.0–3.8 bya) enriched with **abiotically synthesised organic molecules** — amino acids, sugars, nitrogenous bases and simple acids — formed under the reducing atmosphere (CH₄, NH₃, H₂, H₂O) energised by UV radiation and lightning.…

rows.text: Most-tested: Miller–Urey (2022). Diagram-worthy: the Miller–Urey apparatus loop (boiler → chamber with electrodes → condenser → trap).

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: **Reducing atmosphere = accumulation:** without free O₂ to burn them, organics could build up for millions of years — the precondition of the primordial soup.

rows.label: Key points
rows.text: Oparin–Haldane: reducing atmosphere (CH4, NH3, H2, H2O) + UV/lightning → simple organics → primordial soup → macromolecules → coacervates/protobionts → RNA-first self-replication → first anaerobic heterotrophic cells → photosynthesis adds O2.  ·  Miller–Urey 1953: CH4 + NH3 + H2 + H2O vapour + electric discharge, one week → glycine, alanine, aspartic, glutamic acids + organic compounds; supports chemical evolution.

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: Amino acids have been found in carbonaceous meteorites — organics form in space too, supporting supply routes to early Earth.

rows.text: ## 1. Topic Introduction — How the First Cell Arose Life did not appear fully formed: chemical evolution on the early Earth assembled molecules, then self-replicating systems, then cells.
